comment: Input 6 (MODE_CV_INPUT) is declared in the code with no widget on the panel and cannot be clicked. The tooltips on outputs 2 and 3 read 'X left AND Y left' and 'X left XOR Y left', but the code feeds them the right-hand channel. The Z left and Z right outputs are taken from the vector lanes the other way round from the pulse and logic outputs, so the channel fed by the left input arrives at Z right.
